difficulty_reason: The nonroutine core constructs simultaneous row/column weights converting bordered Pfaffians to the parity-dependent kernel; proves the tailored identities by multivariate degree bounds, divisibility and reciprocal-pair specializations; and matches them to the independently derived antisymmetrizer recurrence for the Robbins deformation. Both even and odd stabilization chains remain explicit. This is not merely substitution into the classical Littlewood identity or generic Pfaffian expansion.
